expose.title: Expose to domains
expose.developerHint: The compiled governance entries + cron / full-refresh controls
expose.introOperational: Choose entities from <mono>{catalog}</mono> and the domains that may use them. Operational sources sync a governed copy into each domain — there is no live federation.
expose.introWarehouse: Choose tables from <mono>{catalog}</mono> and the domains that may use them. Exposure compiles straight to policy — an unexposed external table reads zero rows for everyone.
expose.selectedCount: {count, plural, one {# table selected} other {# tables selected}}

msg.organizeFailed: The catalog could not be organized right now.
msg.revokeConfirm: Revoke "{name}"? Live reads of its tables drop to zero rows for the assigned domains.

policy.compiled: {count, plural, other {# table(s) compiled to policy}}

catalogStage.noSnapshot: No snapshot of this catalog yet. Take one to browse and pick tables.
catalogStage.unreachable: Catalog not queryable — register it, then Refresh. {detail}

source.title: Mirror the source structure
source.desc: One folder per source schema — best when the source is well-organized.

osDomains.title: Mirror the OS domains
osDomains.desc: One folder per domain — makes Assign near-automatic (folder → domain).

starter.title: Starter set
starter.desc: Financial, Customer, Product, Orders, Logistics, HR, Marketing, Reference, Operational.

empty.title: Empty
empty.desc: Start with just Unsorted; add folders yourself, then let AI fill them.

organizeStage.intro: Organizing groups related tables so you can expose a whole area at once. This is optional — exposure never waits on it.
organizeStage.errorTail: {error} You can still expose by schema — organizing never blocks it.
organizeStage.unreachable: Catalog unreachable — showing the schema view.
organizeStage.searchPlaceholder: Search names, folders, or the AI’s reason…

assignStage.name: Name
assignStage.operationalSyncOnly: Operational sources sync; there is no live mode.
assignStage.fullRefresh: Full refresh each run (re-copy the whole table)
assignStage.hourlyDefault: Synced copies refresh hourly by default.
assignStage.actionsDeveloper: Compiles to <mono>sf_get_record</mono> · <mono>sf_search</mono> (read), <mono>sf_create_record</mono> · <mono>sf_update_record</mono> (write-approval). Writes stay compiled-out until an admin approves.

reviewStage.impactReadWrite: Agents in {hasDomains, select, yes {{domains}} other {the assigned domains}} may READ {reads}; WRITE {writes} (held for admin approval).
reviewStage.impactReadOnly: Agents in {hasDomains, select, yes {{domains}} other {the assigned domains}} may READ {reads}; no writes.
reviewStage.impactWriteOnly: Agents in {hasDomains, select, yes {{domains}} other {the assigned domains}} may WRITE {writes} (held for admin approval).
reviewStage.impact: {count, plural, one {# table} other {# tables}} become readable by {hasDomains, select, yes {{domains}} other {no domains yet}}, {mode, select, live {live} other {as a synced copy}}, at the {tier} tier. Everyone else stays at zero rows.
reviewStage.removedWarning: {count, plural, one {# selected table was removed in the latest snapshot: {tables}. Exposing it will read zero rows until the source returns.} other {# selected tables were removed in the latest snapshot: {tables}. Exposing them will read zero rows until the source returns.}}

registries.title: Tenant connectors
registries.intro: Admin only, and tenant-wide: what this tenant is allowed to connect to at all. These are not your connections — nothing here links an account to you.

oauthApps.label: Sign-in apps (Google & Microsoft)
oauthApps.sub: the Google and Microsoft apps people sign in with, for drives and mail

gallery.blurbOperational: Federate this database as a governed catalog — query live, import tables, keep copies fresh with scheduled sync.
gallery.blurbStreaming: Federate topics as governed tables and land them in the lakehouse with scheduled sync.
gallery.blurbWarehouse: Federate this lakehouse as a governed catalog — query live, then import tables.
gallery.empty: No connectors are available on this deployment yet.
gallery.wipBanner: Connectors are under construction. Every connector below is a preview that hasn’t been end-to-end tested yet — you can configure and explore them, but don’t rely on them in production until they’re verified.

accounts.title: Accounts for the chat
accounts.intro: Notion, Microsoft 365, OneDrive and Google Drive in the Home chat. Each person connects their own account; the chat reads only what that account may read.

kinds.notion: pages and databases, via Notion's official MCP server
kinds.microsoft365: Outlook mail and calendar, Teams, SharePoint and OneDrive (read); optionally drafting and sending mail, confirmed per message
kinds.gdrive: your Google Drive files, Docs and Sheets (read)

accounts.companyTitle: Company-wide visibility ships with the company scope (#333); until then a Company connection is visible in its home domain only.
accounts.companyLater: The whole company: after company scope ships
accounts.signInHint: Sign-in: each person connects their own account (recommended).
accounts.sharedToggle: Use ONE shared account for everyone instead
accounts.sharedWarn: Everyone in the domain will read and act with the account you connect, including data they could not open themselves. Promoting the connection later turns this off again until you re-confirm.
accounts.sharedAck: I understand and want a shared credential
accounts.mailSendHint: Off by default. On: each person's sign-in also asks for Mail.ReadWrite and Mail.Send, and the chat can draft or send a plain-text mail as them, only after they confirmed the full message.
accounts.emptyDomain: No account connections yet. Add one above for your domain.
accounts.emptyOther: No account connections yet. Ask your domain admin to add one, or add one for yourself.
accounts.canSendMail: can draft and send mail (confirmed per message)
accounts.mailNotGranted: your sign-in does not allow sending yet: Reconnect to allow sending
accounts.ungranted: {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}} connected without send permission (they are asked to reconnect before drafting or sending)

signInApps.cantConnect: Can't connect yet: the {provider} sign-in app isn't set up.
signInApps.cantConnectAsk: Can't connect yet: the {provider} sign-in app isn't set up. Ask your admin to set up the {provider} sign-in app.
signInApps.addedSetUp: Added. Next step: set up the {provider} sign-in app.
signInApps.addedAsk: Added. Next step: ask your admin to set up the {provider} sign-in app.
signInApps.entraAdmin: Requires Mail.ReadWrite and Mail.Send in your Entra app registration.
signInApps.entraUnknown: Requires Mail.ReadWrite and Mail.Send in the Microsoft sign-in app.
signInApps.entraAsk: Requires Mail.ReadWrite and Mail.Send: ask your admin to add the permissions in the Microsoft sign-in app.
